case_name: Mrs. Gitika Barman vs Sanjeev Barman
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed an application under Section 12/18/19/20/22/23 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005. She alleged domestic violence and sought relief. The trial court directed the respondent to pay a lump sum relief.

legal_principles.principle: The scope of section 20 of the DV Act is much wider than section 125 Cr.P.C.
legal_principles.held: section 20(3) of the Domestic Violence Act is an independent provision and in fact its scope is much wider than the section 125 Cr.P.C
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 20

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider the provisions of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, when deciding a case.
